prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck and back strain after a low-speed head-on collision. The patient had 21 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1454; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a low-speed head-on collision with complaints of neck and low back pain, consistent with the mechanism of injury reported. Initial examination documented restricted cervical range of motion and paraspinal muscle tenderness, while neurological screening and straight-leg raise testing were within normal limits. Imaging was not indicated based on clinical findings. The patient completed 21 supervised visits combining manual therapy, therapeutic exercise, and home program instruction. Course of care extended somewhat beyond the typical timeframe for a strain of this type, with gradual improvement in range of motion and pain scores over the treatment period. No prior injury or treatment to the cervical or lumbar regions is known. Billed services reflect the planned treatment plan, with no duplicated charges identified. Patient was discharged to self-management with return precautions provided. Prognosis for full recovery is good.
